scope: Evidence-bound composition of the retained native direct protected unit-address exchange with the retained one-to-six-bridge source-route and Reply Network grammar; no live physical bridge, routed native command capture or site data

grounding.finding: The literal native direct mutation is CAL A3 20 4E <destination> <one-use challenge> to the source unit. It is unchecksummed on the direct network and carries a separately allocated PCI confirmation byte.
Native direct success is the exact parameter-0x20/data-0x4E ACK from the destination address; definitive rejection is the fixed ReaddressNak from the source address.
The same parameter-0x20 unlock used by readdress has an already accepted one-to-six-bridge encoding, and its one-byte challenge is bound to the exact Reply Network and remote source unit.
Retained original receiver matrices establish one-through-six Reply Network parsing and rejection of first-bridge, remaining-route, remote-unit and CAL-selector mismatches.
The retained native topology evidence pins database bridge resolution and the one-to-six source-route bound used before any physical request.

claimed_behavior: SET //PROJECT/NETWORK/p/SOURCE Address DESTINATION resolves the complete topology before I/O and supports the configured direct network or one through six bridges.
The service requires exactly one route-correlated IDENTIFY4 source reply and no destination reply before requesting the challenge.
The challenge must be one byte from the exact route, source unit and parameter 0x20. The protected address STORE is sent exactly once and never registered for replay.
Success requires the allocated positive PCI confirmation plus the exact Reply Network, destination unit and fixed parameter-0x20/data-0x4E ACK. A definitive NAK must match the route and old source.
Only the target network's volatile physical cache and move event commit after the captured PCI-generation guard; the persistent database address remains unchanged.
acceptance: Transport tests pin literal one- and six-bridge requests, exact challenge/route/source/destination/ACK matching, and zero replay after a lost mutation confirmation.
Service tests prove routed duplicate guards, reject neighbouring Reply Network receipts and commit only the addressed network cache while leaving its database unit address unchanged.
A real cmqttd daemon test completes the one-bridge scripted exchange through the shared simulated PCI and observes one protected STORE.
limits: There is no retained native wire capture or original command execution for routed unit readdress. The routed request is a bounded protocol composition of the literal native direct CAL with separately retained native source-route and Reply Network semantics; this does not claim GUI or native C-Gate routed-command parity.
No physical bridge or remote unit completed the mutation in acceptance. The exact scripted ACK proves protocol correlation, not physical execution.

The destination ACK is the retained native completion boundary. cmqttd does not add an invented post-write parameter readback or claim nonvolatile address persistence, reboot survival or power-cycle survival.
A lost confirmation or receipt is outcome-uncertain, retires the programming lane and is never replayed automatically.
